content:
## 题目
Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}-16&-9&20&-12\\-4&3&5&4\\0&6&0&8\end{bmatrix}\). Find a non-zero vector in the column space of \(A\).

## 解法
I will use the matrix method.  
The column space of \(A\) is spanned by the columns of \(A\). Therefore, any column of \(A\) is in the column space.  
The first column of \(A\) is

\[
\begin{bmatrix}
-16\\
-4\\
0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

Since its first entry is \(-16\neq 0\), this vector is non-zero.

## 约定
I choose the first column of \(A\) as the required non-zero vector.

来源：自行选取

## 答案
A non-zero vector in the column space of \(A\) is

\[
\begin{bmatrix}
-16\\
-4\\
0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：向量
- 结论：-16 | -4 | 0
- 约定：取 \(A\) 的第一列作为所求非零向量
- 约定来源：自行选取

## 检验
This vector is exactly the first column of \(A\), so it belongs to the column space of \(A\). It is non-zero because its first entry is \(-16\neq 0\).
